overview: The meeting reviewed Design Option A for the school building project, outlining its scope as a baseline code-repair scenario and its lack of eligibility for state funding.

items.title: Design Option A: Code Repair Scenario
items.summary: Matt Rice and Jenny Graham reviewed the baseline code-repair option, which addresses structural, system, and accessibility upgrades without changing the building footprint. The project team stated the option costs $437 million and is ineligible for MSBA reimbursement because it fails to meet the district's educational plan or support program expansion.
